label: Estate Planning
title: Plan for
intro: Estate planning is about more than deciding what happens to your assets after your death.
criteria: You are creating your first estate plan.
Your family or financial circumstances have changed.
You want to plan for future financial and healthcare decisions.
You want to review documents prepared years ago.
coverage: Wills
Direct certain asset distributions and nominate trusted people.
Trusts
Manage and transfer assets during life and after death.
Powers of attorney
Designate someone to assist with financial and legal matters.
Medical directives
Record healthcare wishes and designate a decision-maker.

label: Guardianships
tagline: Protect a loved one who needs help
title: Protect someone
intro: When an individual is unable to make certain personal, medical, or financial decisions independently, a guardianship may provide the legal authority necessary for another person to act on their behalf.
criteria: Someone needs support with personal, medical or financial decisions.
You need to understand whether a less restrictive alternative is available.
You are considering a guardianship petition.
You need help understanding responsibilities after appointment.
coverage: Guardianship petitions
Guidance on petitions and appointment proceedings.
Personal decisions
Guardianship relating to healthcare, care and living arrangements.
Property and finances
Guidance on managing assets, income, expenses and financial matters.
Ongoing responsibilities
Help with court filings, reporting, records and fiduciary obligations.

Trademark maintenance

label: Marital Agreements
tagline: Protect your assets before or during marriage
title: Protect assets
intro: Conversations about finances, property, and future responsibilities are an important part of planning a life together.
criteria: You are considering a prenuptial agreement before marriage.
You want to consider a postnuptial agreement during marriage.
You want to clarify property, debts or other financial responsibilities.
You need to coordinate a marital agreement with estate planning.
coverage: Prenuptial agreements
Financial and property arrangements before marriage.
Postnuptial agreements
Agreements about financial matters during marriage.
Property and obligations
Consideration of assets, business interests, debts and inheritances.
Estate planning coordination
Consider how a marital agreement and estate plan interact.
